family: Body infographic / explanatory research graphic — Family B of SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md.
primary_job: Explain a mechanism, comparison, process, governance structure, boundary, sequence, or cross-section synthesis more efficiently than prose alone.

semantic_density.rationale: Medium-to-high semantic density is the deliberate target: retain comparison dimensions, causal steps, historical stages, and consequences that are load-bearing for the article's thesis (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §2). This is the field that mechanically distinguishes this artifact from visual/thumbnail, which is deliberately low.

visual_density.rationale: Compress visual chrome, not the argument: reduce boxes, fills, icons, borders, and repeated labels while preserving every load-bearing relationship (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §2, §4). Visual density is low even though semantic density is high — the two controls are independent (§2).

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: Short stable semantic labels only (e.g. TOKEN MARKET, CUSTODIAN, MINT / REDEEM), never mutable article/section titles, dates, captions, citations, or promotional copy (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §4.3; ARTICLE-VISUAL-PUBLICATION-HANDOFF.md §1).
text_policy.enforcement: scripts/validate-composition-plan.mjs checks composition.label_strategy.max_labels against this family's ceiling of 8. Ceilings were stated before SUE-628 and nothing checked them: the rejected SUE-570 plate shipped 22 labels against visual/body-infographic's ceiling of 8 (signature F7).

composition.dominant_structure: One primary question, answered by 2-4 strong semantic modules, one explicit reading path, and a consequence/tension/output when needed (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §4.2).
composition.reading_path: Single explicit path; a forking reading path is a split trigger (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6).
composition.negative_space: generous but subordinate to the comparison/mechanism structure
composition.chrome_level: low-to-medium; prefer typography and spacing hierarchy over cards, fills, and heavy borders (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §4)

enclosure_budget.derivation: Typography carries structure through four independent channels — size, weight, case and asymmetric whitespace — for roughly 3-4 distinguishable tiers. Enclosure becomes necessary only where the structure is NOT hierarchical: independent parallel categories with no rank relation, where size and weight have no 'which is bigger' answer to encode. Everything else drawn as a box is a tier typography could have carried (benchmarks/EDITORIAL-INFOGRAPHIC-INFORMATION-DESIGN.md T10, contradiction C2).
enclosure_budget.negative_evidence: The rejected SUE-570 body infographic drew 12 enclosures for 4 load-bearing modules — cards containing chips containing text (signature F2).

position_convention.acceptance_test: Name the axes. If neither dimension of the plate can be given a semantic name, the plate is a list wearing a diagram's clothes.
position_convention.rationale: In the conditionally-acceptable chart lane, coordinates are arithmetic on values, so measuring the picture recovers the data. In the rejected infographic the modules sat at hand-assigned coordinates in a 2x2 arrangement whose axes encoded nothing — borrowing the appearance of a matrix without the encoding. 'topological' exists so that a plate whose position honestly means nothing can say so; the failure is undeclared position, not absent position (T1, contradiction C1, signature F1).

audience_adaptation.domain-expert: Legend optional; may use denser domain encodings (e.g. custody/rights-chain vocabulary) without in-frame expansion.
audience_adaptation.domain-practitioner: Moderate label density with brief glossing on first use.
audience_adaptation.beginner-learner: Expand every acronym in-frame and keep to the low end of the module range (2 modules).
audience_adaptation.child-upper-elementary: Avoid this artifact class for a genuinely child-targeted piece unless the mechanism is essential; if used, cap at 2 modules, use plain-language labels only, avoid abstract encodings, and never make the legend load-bearing — simplifying the audience must never simplify the truth (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §9 constraint 1).

renderer_preference.rule: Default toward a deterministic or strongly structured renderer whenever labels, topology, arrows, evidence, comparison rows, chronology, or exact relationships must remain stable and auditable. Use generative rendering only when the body visual is primarily qualitative and can tolerate image-model variance without weakening meaning; exact values and labels never ride on a generative raster model (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §4.4).
renderer_preference.generative_boundary: Plain 'generative' is not representable for this family — absent from the enum, not merely discouraged. A generative raster model may never own exact numbers, exact labels, citations, factual relation geometry, load-bearing connectors or typography. Under 'hybrid' or 'generative_support' the non-deterministic step contributes bounded non-load-bearing material only, and a load-bearing generative contribution is a routing error rather than a style choice.

requirements: module boundaries readable at the target viewport — reached by a declared strategy, not by uniform downscaling (see strategy.invalid below)
2-4 strong modules rather than many tiny panels
line weight/contrast that survives mobile rendering
labels only where they improve comprehension
no reliance on hover or desktop-only interaction

strategy.note: min_effective_type_px is the rendered size at the stated viewport, not the authored size. Every asset in the SUE-570 set — including the two conditionally-acceptable charts — is a fixed-viewBox SVG whose only response to a narrow viewport is uniform scaling, producing 5.2-10.1px effective type. This defect is systemic rather than infographic-specific (signature F5, trait T9).

readability_gate.rationale: Mobile readability is a hard gate for body infographics, not an aspiration (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §5; SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §10).

split_rule.rule: One plate, one primary question. Split when more than one primary question is being answered, the reading path forks repeatedly, important labels become too small on mobile, more than 4 major modules compete for attention, the visual requires dashboard-like micro-panels, or semantic structure remains valid only after zooming. Do not solve information overload by shrinking modules, fonts, or labels (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6; SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §10).

acceptance: passes VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md with a named new_information item beyond adjacent prose
answers exactly one primary question per plate
2-4 load-bearing modules with one explicit reading path
exact values, topology, or chronology remain deterministic/traceable
no mutable article title, date, caption, or citation baked into the artwork
carries a composition plan validating against schemas/composition-plan.schema.json
declares what spatial position encodes, and passes the name-the-axes test
declares a mobile strategy from reflow|restack|replate|split with >= 14px effective type at 390px
reject: mini dashboard or multi-panel report crammed into one plate
dense infographic collage or icon-per-cell composition
more than one primary question on a single plate
structure that only becomes legible after zooming on mobile
minimalism achieved by deleting load-bearing dimensions, exceptions, or consequences (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §5)
spatial position that encodes no relation while implying that it does (signature F1)
more drawn enclosures than parallel-category boundaries (signature F2)
a module whose only content is a sentence inside a border (signature F3)
uniform downscaling offered as a mobile strategy (signature F5)

composition_plan.rationale: AES-V2.16b / SUE-628. Before this, the path from article to image carried a semantic_spec of three string arrays with no relation model, reading order, geometry, enclosure budget or mobile strategy — which is the gap every SUE-570 failure signature except one escaped through (evals/negative-baselines/SUE-570-INFOGRAPHIC-FORENSICS.md). A plate in this family is planned before it is rendered, and the plan is the versioned artifact.
